HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   C. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.

7. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

12. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of International Instruments of Human Rights; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
